Title: Next.js: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Image Optimization API when AVIF files are used
Description:
A vulnerability in the underlying `libheif` library used by `sharp` which Next.js uses for image optimization can lead to remote code execution when AVIF files are optimized.

Until a fix has propagated, optimization of AVIF files is disabled.
AffectedVersions: All versions starting from 10.0.0 before 15.5.24, all versions starting from 16.0.0 before 16.3.3
NotImpacted: All versions before 10.0.0, all versions starting from 15.5.24 before 16.0.0, all versions starting from 16.3.3
